# TypeScript Generic Specialist Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Frontend > TypeScript

## Overview

Creates reusable generic functions, classes, and interfaces with proper type inference, constraints, and variance annotations

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [typescript-generic-specialist-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
typescript-generic-specialist-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@typescript-generic-specialist` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Design generic functions with inferred return types
- Implement generic classes with proper variance
- Create constrained generics with extends clauses
- Build generic factory patterns and builders

## Technology Standards Applied

- **Generics Guide**: Official generics documentation and patterns
- **Type Inference**: How TypeScript infers generic type parameters
- **Variance**: Covariance and contravariance annotations
